messages:
marta-cs: Heads up — Cobalt Systems renewal is in the window next week (target sign by 2026-03-30). Onboarding currently ~65% (security/KMS review still open). Procurement needs vendor code + PO; customer asked to move to a 9-month term and is requesting ~10% off list. DocuSign is failing for their EU signer. Need alignment on pricing math, legal addendum for KMS, and an e-sign fallback. cc @ryan-se @tara-legal @ben-finance

ryan-se: Got it. What are the current onboarding blockers?

marta-cs: Security review (customer-managed KMS question) + entitlement mapping outstanding. Enablement kickoff gated on PO.

ben-finance: If we accept 9mo term, pricing/proration rules apply — can someone confirm seat count and exact start date so I can run numbers?

tara-legal: I can draft a short KMS addendum and update the SOW for 9 months. Quick Q: do we want to accept customer-managed KMS in principle, subject to the addendum? If yes I’ll add the clause.

alex-se: I have the entitlement mapping doc ready to share. Also recommend we provision temporary Dedicated seats to hit perf SLOs during onboarding ramp.

marta-cs: Customer prefers customer-managed KMS. They'll provide KMS attestation once legal clause is in. Start date proposed 2026-04-01. Initial seats 18, expect to true-up to 20 by month 3.

ryan-se: That helps. For e-sign: DocuSign errored with EU signer (eIDAS mismatch). Any alternate e-sign approach? @tara-legal

marta-cs: They're pushing for e-sign but will accept secure upload + wet-sign if needed. Procurement asked if we can accept wire instead of card.

tara-legal: We can accept e-sign with explicit clause re: international signatures. I'll add: "electronic signature acceptance for international entities where supported; otherwise wet-sign permitted". Also need signatory authority confirmation.

ben-finance: For billing: Net30 preferred. Wire is fine; just need billing entity on PO to match invoicing. Marta, please ensure PO includes billing entity and vendor code.

marta-cs: Baseline list is $120/seat/month. They requested 10% off list. Confirming: 18 seats * $120 * 9 months = $19,440 pre-discount; with 10% discount => $17,496 total. I'll confirm PO timing — procurement said EOD Wednesday.

alex-se: Entitlement mapping (customer-facing link): https://redwood.internal/docs/cobalt-entitlements — will update playbook accordingly.

marta-cs: I'll attempt DocuSign with EU signer option first; if it fails we'll switch to secure upload and request wet-signed PDF.

docusign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0x9a3 created by marta-cs — Status: sent to cobalt-signer@cobalt.com

tara-legal: Draft SOW snippet (inline): ```Term: 9 months; KMS: customer-managed KMS accepted subject to KMS addendum; Pricing: see Finance calc; Signature: electronic signatures accepted where valid.```

ben-finance: Quick sanity check on math: 18 * 120 * 9 = 19,440 pre-discount; minus 10% = 17,496. Confirming monthly invoice cadence vs single upfront invoice?

marta-cs: Customer prefers single invoice for the contracted period but will accept monthly if we require it. They asked for Net30. I'll push for single invoice but expect monthly by default.

ryan-se: I'll hold the canary rollout until contracts are signed. @jana-enable please prep two kickoff sessions (technical + admin) for the week after sign.

jana-enable: Can do week of 2026-04-06. Also capture feedback: they requested clearer SSO mapping docs and an abbreviated runbook for first-week admins — recommend we assign owners for doc updates.

marta-cs: Assigning doc updates to @alex-se and training to @jana-enable.

alex-se: Accepting assignment — will submit onboarding playbook updates by 2026-04-02.

marta-cs: Update: DocuSign returned "signature country mismatch" error. Swapping to secure upload. I'll post the upload link here when done.

docusign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0x9a3 — Status: failed -> action required.

marta-cs: Uploaded secure link: https://files.redwood.com/upload/abc123 — sent to cobalt procurement for wet-sign. They acknowledged and said wire will be used.

ben-finance: Wire accepted. Please send PO copy and wire instructions to billing@redwood.com; ensure billing entity matches invoice.

ryan-se: Plan recap: 1) Legal to finalize SOW + KMS addendum by 2026-04-01; 2) Finance to confirm invoice form & wire details; 3) Enablement scheduled week of 2026-04-06; 4) Onboarding docs updated by 2026-04-02; 5) Marta to update renewal risk tracker once PO received.

tara-legal: I'll post final SOW in the contract thread and notify Legal Ops when done.

marta-cs: Thanks team — I'll close the loop here once PO is in and upload the signed contract.
